opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Physiological Society members (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Awards can only be used to attend Society meetings and Society-sponsored meetings.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events, covering registration, meeting dinners, and a contribution toward travel and accommodation (up to the total value of the award) on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Physiological Society members. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Physiological Society members. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications should be physiological in nature. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Physiological Society Representatives and members. Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. Funding cannot be used for salary costs, conference attendance or membership payments.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Members will normally only be awarded this funding once during their period of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries, but not staff salaries. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
